sources/agentic-memory-unified-framework.title: Source: Agentic Memory — Unified LTM and STM Management for LLM Agents
sources/agentic-memory-unified-framework.summary: AgeMem paper (2026): unified framework exposing memory operations as tool-based actions, trained via three-stage RL, outperforming baselines across five long-horizon benchmarks.

sources/agentic-rag-survey.title: Source: Agentic RAG Survey
sources/agentic-rag-survey.summary: ArXiv survey classifying agentic RAG systems by agent cardinality, control structure, autonomy level, and knowledge representation — identifying reflection, planning, tool use, and multi-agent collaboration as key patterns.

sources/ai-training-2026-synthetic-human.title: Source: AI Training in 2026 — Anchoring Synthetic Data in Human Truth
sources/ai-training-2026-synthetic-human.summary: 2026 perspective: web training data is exhausted; competitive advantage lies in human-synthetic data flywheels with governance guardrails to prevent model collapse.

sources/ango-file-over-app.title: Source: File Over App — Steph Ango
sources/ango-file-over-app.summary: Obsidian CEO Steph Ango argues that files must outlast apps — digital artifacts should exist in controllable, accessible formats independent of any software vendor.

sources/antigravity-post-code-ai-workflo.title: Source: Karpathy's LLM Knowledge Bases: The Post-Code AI Workflow
sources/antigravity-post-code-ai-workflo.summary: Broadest analysis of Karpathy's LLM KB shift: the 6-step workflow, developer role transformation, real-world applications across 7 domains, hallucination contamination risk, and minimum viable setup.

sources/cache-augmented-generation.title: Source: Don't Do RAG — When Cache-Augmented Generation is All You Need
sources/cache-augmented-generation.summary: ArXiv paper proposing CAG as a RAG alternative that preloads all documents into KV cache — achieving 10x faster inference (0.85s vs 9.24s) with higher BERTScores, but limited to manageable knowledge base sizes.

sources/claimify-claim-extraction.title: Source: Claimify — Extracting High-Quality Claims from LLM Outputs
sources/claimify-claim-extraction.summary: Microsoft's Claimify (ACL 2025) decomposes LLM outputs into independently verifiable atomic claims via a 4-stage pipeline, achieving 99% entailment with source sentences.

sources/claude-code-agentic-coding.title: Source: Claude Code and the Agentic Coding Revolution
sources/claude-code-agentic-coding.summary: Eight 2026 software development trends: coding-to-coordination shift, multi-agent coordination, $2.5B Claude Code revenue, computer use capabilities, and real-world impact at Rakuten/TELUS/Zapier.

sources/colbert-late-interaction.title: Source: Late Interaction Retrieval Models — ColBERT, ColPali, ColQwen
sources/colbert-late-interaction.summary: Weaviate overview of late interaction models: ColBERT keeps token-level embeddings with MaxSim scoring, achieving 100x speedup over cross-encoders; ColPali/ColQwen extend this to visual documents.

sources/dairai-llm-knowledge-bases-archi.title: Source: LLM Knowledge Bases: A System Architecture Overview
sources/dairai-llm-knowledge-bases-archi.summary: DAIR.AI Academy deep-dive on the four-phase operational cycle (ingest, compile, query, maintain) of Karpathy's LLM knowledge base system, emphasizing no vector infrastructure needed at personal scale.

sources/databricks-agent-design-patterns.title: Source: Agent System Design Patterns (Databricks)
sources/databricks-agent-design-patterns.summary: Databricks design pattern spectrum from simple LLM+prompt through deterministic chains, single-agent, to multi-agent systems with orchestrator-worker, supervisor, and router patterns.

sources/decodingai-second-brain-rag.title: Source: Build Your Second Brain AI Assistant — LLMs and RAG
sources/decodingai-second-brain-rag.summary: Production-grade second brain using the FTI (Feature/Training/Inference) architecture: Notion → ETL → MongoDB vector search + Llama 3.1 fine-tuning + ZenML orchestration — the enterprise-scale counterpart to Karpathy's personal approach.

sources/domain-adaptive-pretraining-dapt.title: Source: A Practical Guide to Domain-Adaptive Pretraining
sources/domain-adaptive-pretraining-dapt.summary: DAPT adds an intermediate domain-specific pretraining step between general pretraining and task fine-tuning; operates on unlabeled data; combined with TAPT yields best results.

sources/epoch-context-window-growth.title: Source: LLMs Now Accept Longer Inputs — Epoch AI
sources/epoch-context-window-growth.summary: Epoch AI analysis showing frontier LLM context windows growing ~30x/year since mid-2023, with effective usage growing even faster at ~250x in 9 months.

sources/forte-building-second-brain.title: Source: Building a Second Brain — Tiago Forte
sources/forte-building-second-brain.summary: Tiago Forte's BASB methodology: CODE workflow (Capture, Organize, Distill, Express), PARA folder system (Projects, Areas, Resources, Archive), and Progressive Summarization — a complete framework for building an external digital repository that augments human cognition.

sources/gallagher-second-brain-knowledge.title: Source: Using LLMs as a Second Brain — From Notes to Knowledge Graphs
sources/gallagher-second-brain-knowledge.summary: Practitioner account of building the Knowledge Graph Kit (MCP server): SQLite + ChromaDB graph with four node types, contrasting structure-first (graph) vs. text-first (markdown) approaches to personal knowledge management.

sources/glenrhodes-karpathy-workflow.title: Source: Andrej Karpathy's LLM-Powered Knowledge Base Workflow
sources/glenrhodes-karpathy-workflow.summary: Technical walkthrough of Karpathy's workflow emphasizing the 'filing loop' where query results compound the knowledge base, and the product gap for non-technical users.

sources/gpt-ner-named-entity-recognition.title: Source: GPT-NER — Named Entity Recognition via Large Language Models
sources/gpt-ner-named-entity-recognition.summary: GPT-NER transforms NER from sequence labeling to text generation using special marker tokens, achieving supervised-comparable performance and excelling in few-shot settings.

sources/graphiti-temporal-knowledge-grap.title: Source: Graphiti — Temporal Context Graphs for AI Agents
sources/graphiti-temporal-knowledge-grap.summary: Graphiti: open-source temporal graph framework for AI agents with time-windowed facts, incremental updates, hybrid retrieval (semantic + BM25 + graph), and full provenance — the middle ground between markdown wikis and enterprise KGs.

sources/graphrag-microsoft-research.title: Source: GraphRAG — Unlocking LLM Discovery on Narrative Private Data
sources/graphrag-microsoft-research.summary: Microsoft Research's GraphRAG system uses LLM-extracted knowledge graphs with Leiden community detection and hierarchical summarization to dramatically outperform baseline RAG on holistic and cross-document queries.

sources/hn-vector-database-debate.title: Source: Do You Need a Vector Database? (HN Discussion)
sources/hn-vector-database-debate.summary: Hacker News practitioner debate: pgvector and Elasticsearch handle most cases; specialized vector DBs only justified at billion-vector scale; FAISS/Vespa.ai as middle ground; real question is 'do you need ANN search?'

sources/huggingface-matryoshka-embedding.title: Source: Introduction to Matryoshka Embedding Models
sources/huggingface-matryoshka-embedding.summary: Hugging Face tutorial on Matryoshka Representation Learning: training embeddings that can be truncated to any dimension with minimal quality loss, preserving 98.37% performance at just 8.3% of original size.

sources/hybrid-search-bm25-splade-vector.title: Source: Hybrid Search for RAG — BM25, SPLADE, and Vector Search Combined
sources/hybrid-search-bm25-splade-vector.summary: PremAI technical guide comparing BM25, SPLADE, and dense vector search with three fusion strategies (RRF, convex combination, DBSF) — showing +26-31% NDCG improvement on BEIR with hybrid approaches.

sources/hybrid-search-rag-optimization.title: Source: Optimizing RAG with Hybrid Search & Reranking
sources/hybrid-search-rag-optimization.summary: VectorHub guide to hybrid search: combining BM25 keyword matching with vector semantic search via RRF fusion, plus transformer-based reranking — with practical database implementation notes.

sources/instructor-library-structured-ex.title: Source: Instructor — Structured Data Extraction Library for LLMs
sources/instructor-library-structured-ex.summary: Instructor is the most popular Python library for structured LLM extraction (3M+ monthly downloads), using Pydantic models with automatic validation and retry across 15+ providers.

sources/jina-colbert-late-interaction.title: Source: What is ColBERT and Late Interaction
sources/jina-colbert-late-interaction.summary: Jina AI's technical overview of ColBERT's late interaction mechanism: per-token embeddings with MaxSim scoring, 180-23,000x faster than BERT reranking, and ColBERTv2's 6-10x storage compression.

sources/karma-multi-agent-knowledge-grap.title: Source: KARMA — Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Knowledge Graph Enrichment
sources/karma-multi-agent-knowledge-grap.summary: NeurIPS 2025 Spotlight paper: nine-agent LLM framework for automated KG enrichment achieving 83.1% accuracy on 1,200 PubMed articles with 18.6% conflict reduction — the research-grade counterpart to markdown wikis.

sources/karpathy-llm-knowledge-bases.title: Source: Thread by @karpathy — LLM Knowledge Bases
sources/karpathy-llm-knowledge-bases.summary: Karpathy describes using LLMs to build and maintain personal markdown wikis from raw ingested sources, with Obsidian as the viewing IDE and LLM-driven Q&A, output generation, and linting.

sources/kg-llm-link-prediction.title: Source: KG-LLM for Link Prediction
sources/kg-llm-link-prediction.summary: KG-LLM converts knowledge graph paths to natural language chain-of-thought prompts and fine-tunes LLMs for multi-hop link prediction, dramatically outperforming traditional embedding methods (F1 0.84-0.98 vs 0.25-0.61).

sources/kg-vs-vector-db-glean.title: Source: Knowledge Graph vs Vector Database — How to Choose Your AI Foundation
sources/kg-vs-vector-db-glean.summary: Glean's analysis of knowledge graphs vs vector databases for enterprise AI: graphs for explainability and multi-hop reasoning, vectors for semantic search, hybrid architectures combining both as the optimal approach.

sources/kggen-knowledge-graph-extraction.title: Source: KGGen — Extracting Knowledge Graphs from Plain Text with Language Models
sources/kggen-knowledge-graph-extraction.summary: KGGen introduces a three-stage LLM pipeline (extract, aggregate, cluster) for knowledge graph construction from text, outperforming GraphRAG by 18% on the novel MINE benchmark for information capture.

sources/knowledge-graph-embeddings-overv.title: Source: Knowledge Graph Embedding — Technical Overview
sources/knowledge-graph-embeddings-overv.summary: Comprehensive overview of KGE models: tensor decomposition (DistMult, ComplEx), geometric (TransE family, RotatE), deep learning (ConvE, CapsE), with training methodology, benchmarks, and relationship to modern LLMs.

sources/llm-kg-construction-survey.title: Source: LLM-Empowered Knowledge Graph Construction — A Survey
sources/llm-kg-construction-survey.summary: Comprehensive survey cataloguing the paradigm shift from rule-based to LLM-driven knowledge graph construction across ontology engineering, knowledge extraction, and knowledge fusion — with schema-based and schema-free taxonomies.

sources/llm-knowledge-distillation-surve.title: Source: LLM Distillation Explained
sources/llm-knowledge-distillation-surve.summary: Overview of LLM knowledge distillation: teacher-student paradigm, white-box vs. black-box methods, rationale-based distillation, and practical deployment benefits.

sources/llms-love-markdown.title: Source: Why LLMs Love Markdown
sources/llms-love-markdown.summary: Quantifies markdown's advantages for LLMs: 25-75% token reduction vs HTML, 89% vs 62% RAG retrieval accuracy, and superior semantic parsing via AST tokenization.

sources/lora-qlora-efficient-fine-tuning.title: Source: LoRA vs. QLoRA — Efficient Fine-Tuning Techniques for LLMs
sources/lora-qlora-efficient-fine-tuning.summary: Comparison of LoRA (low-rank adapter matrices, 90-95% of full quality) and QLoRA (4-bit quantized base + LoRA, 80-90% quality) with detailed memory requirement tables.

sources/markdown-agent-task-format.title: Source: The Case for Markdown as Your Agent's Task Format
sources/markdown-agent-task-format.summary: Advocates markdown+YAML frontmatter over JSON for AI agent task management: human-readable, git-native, agent-compatible, with Unix tooling for querying.

sources/markdowndb-queryable-markdown.title: Source: MarkdownDB — Queryable Markdown Files
sources/markdowndb-queryable-markdown.summary: MarkdownDB indexes markdown files into SQLite for SQL/JSON querying while preserving files on disk — bridging the plain-text vs. database gap.

sources/marp-markdown-presentations.title: Source: Marp — Markdown Presentation Ecosystem
sources/marp-markdown-presentations.summary: Marp converts markdown into presentation slides (HTML, PDF, PowerPoint) — demonstrating that markdown can replace proprietary formats even for visual content.

sources/martinfowler-function-calling-ll.title: Source: Function Calling Using LLMs
sources/martinfowler-function-calling-ll.summary: Martin Fowler site deep-dive on function calling architecture: agent scaffold pattern, security considerations (prompt injection), MCP protocol, and comparison with rules engines.

sources/matuschak-evergreen-notes.title: Source: Evergreen Notes — Andy Matuschak
sources/matuschak-evergreen-notes.summary: Andy Matuschak's evergreen notes system: five principles (atomic, concept-oriented, densely linked, associative ontologies, written for self) for notes that evolve and accumulate insight over time — inspired by Zettelkasten but with distinct emphasis on thinking development.

sources/mcp-model-context-protocol.title: Source: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Specification and Announcement
sources/mcp-model-context-protocol.summary: MCP open standard for AI tool integration: JSON-RPC architecture with Hosts/Clients/Servers, adopted by OpenAI and Google, donated to Linux Foundation in 2025.

sources/mdx-markdown-components.title: Source: MDX — Markdown for the Component Era
sources/mdx-markdown-components.summary: MDX extends markdown with JSX components, enabling interactive content within markdown documents — compiled at build time with no runtime overhead.

sources/microsoft-graphrag.title: Source: GraphRAG — Unlocking LLM Discovery on Narrative Private Data
sources/microsoft-graphrag.summary: Microsoft Research's GraphRAG system constructs knowledge graphs from text via LLM extraction, then uses community-level summaries to answer holistic queries that baseline RAG cannot — with provenance tracking.

sources/microsoft-markitdown.title: Source: Microsoft MarkItDown
sources/microsoft-markitdown.summary: Microsoft's open-source MarkItDown converts PDFs, Office docs, images, and audio to markdown for LLM ingestion — treating markdown as the universal preprocessing format for AI pipelines.

sources/mit-digital-preservation-formats.title: Source: MIT Libraries — File Formats for Long-Term Access
sources/mit-digital-preservation-formats.summary: MIT Libraries recommends plain text (UTF-8) as the preferred preservation format for text content — validating markdown's archival durability from an institutional perspective.

sources/modal-mteb-leaderboard.title: Source: Top Embedding Models on the MTEB Leaderboard
sources/modal-mteb-leaderboard.summary: Modal's analysis of the MTEB leaderboard: 8 task categories, top open-weight models (Qwen3-Embedding-8B, NVIDIA Nemotron, bge-m3), domain-specific outperformance, and the open-source catch-up to proprietary APIs.

sources/multi-agent-collaboration-survey.title: Source: Multi-Agent Collaboration Mechanisms — A Survey of LLMs
sources/multi-agent-collaboration-survey.summary: 2025 survey taxonomizing multi-agent LLM collaboration across five dimensions (actors, types, structures, strategies, protocols) with cooperation/competition/coopetition typology.

sources/ng-agentic-design-patterns.title: Source: Andrew Ng on Agentic Design Patterns
sources/ng-agentic-design-patterns.summary: Andrew Ng's four agentic design patterns (reflection, tool use, planning, multi-agent collaboration) plus enterprise strategy: architecture matters more than model size.

sources/ontogpt-ontology-extraction.title: Source: OntoGPT — LLM-Based Ontological Extraction Tools
sources/ontogpt-ontology-extraction.summary: OntoGPT's SPIRES method uses zero-shot LLM extraction grounded in biomedical ontologies, producing structured output aligned to established terminologies without training data.

sources/pandoc-universal-converter.title: Source: Pandoc — Universal Document Converter
sources/pandoc-universal-converter.summary: Pandoc converts between dozens of markup and document formats via a markdown-centric AST — effectively making markdown the hub of the document format universe.

sources/pebblous-agentic-framework-explo.title: Source: Agentic Framework Big Bang — 3 Paths in Autonomous AI
sources/pebblous-agentic-framework-explo.summary: Three 2025 open-source agent frameworks (agent-lightning, hermes-agent, superpowers) representing RL training, self-improvement, and TDD paths — all bottlenecked by data quality.

sources/pebblous-cheap-ontology.title: Source: LLMs That Compile Knowledge: The Karpathy Methodology and the Democratization of Ontology
sources/pebblous-cheap-ontology.summary: Deep analysis placing Karpathy's markdown wiki within 50 years of ontology history, quantifying the RAG vs. fine-tuning vs. LLM-KB tradeoffs, and identifying data quality as the decisive bottleneck.

sources/pinecone-embedding-models-rundow.title: Source: Choosing an Embedding Model
sources/pinecone-embedding-models-rundow.summary: Pinecone's practical guide comparing OpenAI, Cohere, and E5 embedding models on speed, dimensions, asymmetric search, and MTEB benchmark interpretation.

sources/pinecone-hnsw-explained.title: Source: Hierarchical Navigable Small Worlds (HNSW)
sources/pinecone-hnsw-explained.summary: Pinecone's deep technical walkthrough of the HNSW algorithm: multi-layer graph structure, parameters (M, efConstruction, efSearch), performance characteristics on Sift1M, and memory tradeoffs.

sources/pinecone-rerankers-two-stage.title: Source: Rerankers and Two-Stage Retrieval
sources/pinecone-rerankers-two-stage.summary: Pinecone's guide to cross-encoder reranking: why bi-encoders lose information, how two-stage retrieval (retrieve top-25, rerank to top-3) improves RAG, and practical impact of moving relevant chunks from position 23 to position 1.

sources/promptingguide-chain-of-thought.title: Source: Chain-of-Thought Prompting (Prompt Engineering Guide)
sources/promptingguide-chain-of-thought.summary: DAIR.AI overview of CoT prompting: Wei et al. (2022) technique enabling complex reasoning via intermediate steps, plus Zero-Shot CoT and Auto-CoT variants.

sources/promptingguide-few-shot.title: Source: Few-Shot Prompting (Prompt Engineering Guide)
sources/promptingguide-few-shot.summary: DAIR.AI overview of few-shot prompting: in-context learning via demonstration examples, with research showing format and label distribution matter more than label accuracy.

sources/promptingguide-self-consistency.title: Source: Self-Consistency Prompting (Prompt Engineering Guide)
sources/promptingguide-self-consistency.summary: DAIR.AI overview of self-consistency: Wang et al. (2022) technique sampling multiple CoT reasoning paths and selecting the most frequent answer via majority voting.

sources/promptingguide-tree-of-thoughts.title: Source: Tree of Thoughts Prompting (Prompt Engineering Guide)
sources/promptingguide-tree-of-thoughts.summary: DAIR.AI overview of ToT: Yao et al. (2023) framework generalizing CoT into tree-structured exploration with BFS/DFS search, achieving 25% gains over CoT on Game of 24.

sources/raft-retrieval-augmented-fine-tu.title: Source: RAFT — Adapting Language Model to Domain Specific RAG
sources/raft-retrieval-augmented-fine-tu.summary: UC Berkeley paper combining RAG with fine-tuning: train models to ignore distractor documents and cite verbatim from oracle docs, achieving up to 76% improvement on domain-specific benchmarks.

sources/rag-evaluation-metrics-benchmark.title: Source: RAG Evaluation — Metrics, Benchmarks, and Enterprise Best Practices
sources/rag-evaluation-metrics-benchmark.summary: Comprehensive guide to RAG evaluation covering retrieval metrics (Precision@k, MRR, nDCG), generation metrics (faithfulness, hallucination rate), benchmarks (RAGBench, CRAG), and frameworks (Ragas, ARES, LangSmith).

sources/rag-hallucinations-explained.title: Source: RAG Hallucinations Explained — Causes, Risks, and Fixes
sources/rag-hallucinations-explained.summary: Mindee analysis of RAG hallucination causes (retrieval failure, fusion errors, confidence misalignment) with Stanford data showing 17-33% hallucination rates even in specialized legal RAG tools.

sources/rag-vs-finetuning-agriculture.title: Source: RAG vs Fine-tuning — Pipelines, Tradeoffs, and Agriculture Case Study
sources/rag-vs-finetuning-agriculture.summary: ArXiv paper demonstrating RAG and fine-tuning are complementary: fine-tuning adds +6pp accuracy, RAG adds another +5pp, and combining both improved geographic knowledge transfer from 47% to 72% similarity.

sources/ragflow-rag-review-2025.title: Source: From RAG to Context — A 2025 Year-End Review
sources/ragflow-rag-review-2025.summary: RAGFlow's year-end review arguing RAG is evolving from a retrieval pattern into a Context Engine — combining domain knowledge, tool retrieval, and memory into unified context platforms.

sources/raptor-tree-retrieval.title: Source: RAPTOR — Recursive Abstractive Processing for Tree-Organized Retrieval
sources/raptor-tree-retrieval.summary: ICLR 2024 paper introducing RAPTOR: builds a tree of recursive summaries via GMM clustering, achieving 20% absolute improvement on QuALITY benchmark by enabling multi-level abstraction retrieval.

sources/react-prompting-framework.title: Source: ReAct — Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
sources/react-prompting-framework.summary: Foundational ReAct paper (Yao et al. 2022): interleaving reasoning traces and actions enables LLM agents to plan dynamically, outperforming CoT and action-only approaches.

sources/redis-semantic-vs-keyword-search.title: Source: Semantic Search vs. Keyword Search
sources/redis-semantic-vs-keyword-search.summary: Redis's comprehensive comparison of semantic vs keyword search: complementary failure modes, when to use each, and why production systems need hybrid approaches combining both.

sources/rome-memit-knowledge-editing.title: Source: ROME and MEMIT — Locating and Editing Factual Associations in LLMs
sources/rome-memit-knowledge-editing.summary: ROME uses causal tracing to locate facts in MLP layers, then makes rank-one edits to change individual factual associations; MEMIT scales this to thousands of simultaneous edits.

sources/self-reflective-rag-langgraph.title: Source: Self-Reflective RAG with LangGraph
sources/self-reflective-rag-langgraph.summary: LangChain's implementation guide for self-corrective RAG using LangGraph state machines — covering CRAG (web fallback on poor retrieval), Self-RAG (reflection tokens for quality control), and agentic orchestration.

sources/sivers-plain-text-files.title: Source: Write Plain Text Files — Derek Sivers
sources/sivers-plain-text-files.summary: Derek Sivers argues that plain text files are the only truly future-proof format: portable across all devices, independent of vendors, and readable centuries from now.

sources/storm-automated-wiki-creation.title: Source: STORM — Automating Wikipedia Article Creation with LLMs
sources/storm-automated-wiki-creation.summary: STORM system: multi-perspective question-asking + retrieval → automated Wikipedia-style article generation with FreshWiki evaluation dataset, contrasting single-shot creation vs. Karpathy's accumulating KB.

sources/superannotate-llm-agents-guide.title: Source: LLM Agents — The Ultimate Guide 2026
sources/superannotate-llm-agents-guide.summary: Comprehensive guide to LLM agent architecture: four core components (brain, memory, planning, tools), major frameworks, capabilities, and operational challenges.

sources/superlinked-hybrid-search-rerank.title: Source: Optimizing RAG with Hybrid Search & Reranking
sources/superlinked-hybrid-search-rerank.summary: VectorHub's guide to the full RAG retrieval pipeline: BM25 + vector search fusion via RRF or weighted alpha, followed by transformer-based reranking, with specific model recommendations and performance benchmarks.

sources/synthetic-data-generation-llms.title: Source: The Definitive Guide to Synthetic Data Generation Using LLMs
sources/synthetic-data-generation-llms.summary: Five-step architecture for LLM-driven synthetic data generation (chunk → context → query → evolve → answer) with quality filtering at every stage.

sources/temporal-knowledge-graphs-survey.title: Source: A Survey on Temporal Knowledge Graph — Representation Learning and Applications
sources/temporal-knowledge-graphs-survey.summary: Comprehensive survey of temporal KG representation learning: 10 method categories from TTransE to LLM-based approaches, covering interpolation, extrapolation, entity alignment, and temporal QA.

sources/textbooks-are-all-you-need-phi.title: Source: Textbooks Are All You Need — Microsoft Phi Models
sources/textbooks-are-all-you-need-phi.summary: Microsoft Research demonstrates that 1.3B-parameter phi-1 trained on 'textbook quality' synthetic data matches models 10x larger — data quality decisively outperforms scale.

sources/weaviate-chunking-strategies.title: Source: Chunking Strategies for RAG
sources/weaviate-chunking-strategies.summary: Weaviate's comprehensive guide to text chunking for RAG: fixed-size, recursive, semantic, document-based, and advanced strategies (late chunking, hierarchical, agentic), with the baseline recommendation of 512 tokens and 50-100 token overlap.

sources/weaviate-hybrid-search-explained.title: Source: Hybrid Search Explained
sources/weaviate-hybrid-search-explained.summary: Weaviate's technical explanation of hybrid search combining BM25 keyword scoring with dense vector search via Reciprocal Rank Fusion, including the alpha parameter for tuning the balance.

sources/willison-llm-schemas-structured-.title: Source: Structured Data Extraction from Unstructured Content Using LLM Schemas
sources/willison-llm-schemas-structured-.summary: Simon Willison's LLM 0.23 introduces schema-based structured extraction — the 'single most commercially valuable LLM application' — with FSM-guaranteed JSON output across all major providers.

sources/xenoss-vector-db-comparison.title: Source: Pinecone vs Qdrant vs Weaviate
sources/xenoss-vector-db-comparison.summary: Detailed comparison of the three leading vector databases: Pinecone (managed, compliance-first), Qdrant (Rust-based, feature-rich), and Weaviate (highest QPS at 791, native hybrid search).

concepts/automated-wiki-creation.title: Automated Wiki Creation
concepts/automated-wiki-creation.summary: STORM's approach: single-shot, multi-perspective Wikipedia-style article generation from web search using simulated expert conversations and outline-first synthesis — contrasting with Karpathy's incremental, accumulating KB model.

concepts/cheap-ontology.title: Cheap Ontology
concepts/cheap-ontology.summary: Pebblous framing: LLM wikis replace $10M–$20M enterprise knowledge graphs using only markdown files, LLM APIs, and natural-language schema instructions — democratizing what was once exclusive ontology engineering expertise.

concepts/data-quality-bottleneck.title: Data Quality Bottleneck
concepts/data-quality-bottleneck.summary: In LLM knowledge base pipelines, data quality at the raw input stage — not model capability — is the decisive factor: low-quality ingestion cascades into contaminated wiki content and flawed fine-tuning.

concepts/fine-tuning.title: Fine-Tuning LLMs
concepts/fine-tuning.summary: Adapting pretrained LLMs to domain-specific tasks by training on curated datasets — from full fine-tuning to parameter-efficient methods (LoRA/QLoRA) to hybrid approaches (RAFT).

concepts/hallucination-contamination.title: Hallucination Contamination
concepts/hallucination-contamination.summary: The risk that LLM-generated errors written into a wiki propagate into future queries and fine-tuning, corrupting the knowledge base over time.

concepts/knowledge-base-product-gap.title: Knowledge Base Product Gap
concepts/knowledge-base-product-gap.summary: Karpathy's own acknowledgment that the current LLM-KB is 'a hacky collection of scripts' — and the product opportunity to build polished tooling that makes AI-maintained wikis accessible to non-technical users.

concepts/knowledge-graph.title: Knowledge Graph
concepts/knowledge-graph.summary: Formal representation of knowledge as nodes (entities) and edges (relationships), with three distinct modern approaches: KARMA (automated multi-agent enrichment), Graphiti (temporal context graphs), and Gallagher's Knowledge Graph Kit (personal SQLite graph).

concepts/linting-and-health-checks.title: Linting and Health Checks
concepts/linting-and-health-checks.summary: LLM-driven health checks over the compiled wiki to find inconsistencies, fill data gaps, detect broken links, identify orphan articles, and suggest new content.

concepts/llm-knowledge-base.title: LLM Knowledge Base
concepts/llm-knowledge-base.summary: A personal knowledge base where an LLM authors and maintains all wiki content from raw ingested sources, with humans interacting only via natural language.

concepts/llm-qa-over-documents.title: LLM Q&A Over Documents
concepts/llm-qa-over-documents.summary: Using an LLM agent to answer complex questions over a compiled wiki by reading index files and summaries to navigate to relevant full articles, without needing a vector database.

concepts/markdown-as-universal-interface.title: Markdown as Universal Interface
concepts/markdown-as-universal-interface.summary: The observation that markdown is simultaneously human-readable, LLM-friendly, version-controllable, tool-agnostic, and future-proof — making it the optimal substrate for LLM-maintained knowledge bases.

concepts/multi-agent-systems.title: Multi-Agent Systems for Knowledge Management
concepts/multi-agent-systems.summary: Using networks of specialized LLM agents (rather than a single LLM) to build and maintain knowledge systems — exemplified by KARMA's 9-agent KG enrichment pipeline and STORM's perspective-simulating article creation system.

concepts/obsidian-as-ide.title: Obsidian as IDE
concepts/obsidian-as-ide.summary: Using Obsidian as a read-only frontend IDE to view LLM-maintained wikis, raw sources, and generated visualizations — with the LLM as the actual author.

concepts/personal-knowledge-management.title: Personal Knowledge Management (PKM)
concepts/personal-knowledge-management.summary: The practice of capturing, organizing, and retrieving personal knowledge — transformed by LLMs from manual note-taking (Notion/Obsidian) to AI-compiled, queryable wikis with automatic synthesis and gap-filling.

concepts/plain-text-longevity.title: Plain Text Longevity
concepts/plain-text-longevity.summary: Plain text is the only digital format guaranteed to be readable decades or centuries from now — validated by individual practitioners, Obsidian's CEO, and institutional archivists.

concepts/post-code-ai-workflow.title: Post-Code AI Workflow
concepts/post-code-ai-workflow.summary: Karpathy's framing of a shift in AI-augmented developer work: from code generation as the primary token use, to knowledge compilation and orchestration — 'manipulating knowledge, not code.'

concepts/rag-vs-index-based-retrieval.title: RAG vs. Index-Based Retrieval
concepts/rag-vs-index-based-retrieval.summary: At small-to-medium scale (~100 articles, ~400K words), LLM-maintained index files and one-line summaries can replace vector database RAG for document Q&A.

concepts/retrieval-augmented-generation.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
concepts/retrieval-augmented-generation.summary: The dominant paradigm for grounding LLM outputs in external knowledge: retrieve relevant documents at query time, inject them as context, and generate answers — now evolving into modular, agentic context engines.

concepts/second-brain.title: Second Brain
concepts/second-brain.summary: A personal AI system that stores, organizes, and retrieves the user's own knowledge — implemented either as a markdown wiki (Karpathy), a graph database (Gallagher), or a RAG pipeline (Decoding AI), all using LLMs as the intelligence layer.

concepts/synthetic-data-generation.title: Synthetic Data Generation
concepts/synthetic-data-generation.summary: Using LLMs to generate training data at scale — from textbook-quality corpora to instruction-following datasets — with quality filtering as the critical success factor.

concepts/temporal-knowledge.title: Temporal Knowledge
concepts/temporal-knowledge.summary: Graphiti's core contribution: representing knowledge with temporal validity windows (when a fact became true and when it was superseded) rather than treating facts as eternally true or false — critical for AI agents in dynamic environments.

concepts/text-embeddings.title: Text Embeddings
concepts/text-embeddings.summary: Dense vector representations of text that capture semantic meaning, enabling similarity-based retrieval; the foundation of modern semantic search, RAG, and vector database infrastructure.

concepts/vault-separation.title: Vault Separation
concepts/vault-separation.summary: Steph Ango's (Obsidian CEO) recommendation to maintain a clean human-curated Obsidian vault separately from agent-generated content, preventing hallucination contamination of personal knowledge.

concepts/vector-databases.title: Vector Databases
concepts/vector-databases.summary: Specialized databases for approximate nearest-neighbor (ANN) search over embedding vectors, necessary at billion-vector scale but often overkill for personal or team-scale LLM knowledge bases where pgvector, FAISS, or index-based LLM navigation suffice.

concepts/wiki-compilation.title: Wiki Compilation
concepts/wiki-compilation.summary: The LLM-driven pipeline that converts raw ingested documents into a structured, cross-linked markdown wiki with source summaries and concept articles.

entities/andrej-karpathy.title: Andrej Karpathy
entities/andrej-karpathy.summary: AI researcher and former Tesla/OpenAI lead who pioneered the LLM-maintained personal knowledge base workflow using markdown wikis and Obsidian.

entities/chromadb.title: ChromaDB
entities/chromadb.summary: An open-source embedding database used in Gallagher's Knowledge Graph Kit to provide semantic vector search over graph nodes alongside SQLite structural storage.

entities/dairai.title: DAIR.AI
entities/dairai.summary: An AI education and research organization whose Academy published the definitive system architecture analysis of Karpathy's LLM knowledge base methodology.

entities/dataview.title: Dataview
entities/dataview.summary: An Obsidian community plugin that enables database-like queries over markdown file frontmatter, useful for dynamic views of LLM-maintained wiki metadata.

entities/elvis-saravia.title: Elvis Saravia
entities/elvis-saravia.summary: Founder of DAIR.AI Academy who provided the most thorough system architecture analysis of Karpathy's LLM knowledge base, coining the 'four-phase operational cycle' framework.

entities/faiss.title: FAISS
entities/faiss.summary: Facebook AI Similarity Search -- an open-source library for efficient similarity search and clustering of dense vectors, supporting billions of vectors with disk-based indexing.

entities/freshwiki.title: FreshWiki
entities/freshwiki.summary: An evaluation dataset of recent Wikipedia articles created after LLM training cutoffs, introduced by the STORM project to prevent data leakage in automated wiki generation benchmarks.

entities/google-notebooklm.title: Google NotebookLM
entities/google-notebooklm.summary: Google's AI notebook product that allows users to upload documents and ask questions -- the closest existing product to Karpathy's vision, but lacking persistent wiki compilation and the filing loop.

entities/graphiti.title: Graphiti
entities/graphiti.summary: An open-source framework by Zep for building temporal context graphs where facts have validity windows, designed for AI agents operating in dynamic environments.

entities/karma.title: KARMA
entities/karma.summary: A NeurIPS 2025 Spotlight paper presenting a nine-agent LLM framework for automated knowledge graph enrichment from unstructured scientific text.

entities/llama.title: Llama
entities/llama.summary: Meta's open-source LLM family, with Llama 3.1 8B used in the Decoding AI second-brain RAG pipeline as the fine-tuned summarization model.

entities/marp.title: Marp
entities/marp.summary: A markdown-based presentation framework used within Obsidian to render LLM-generated slide decks as one of the multi-format output options in the knowledge base workflow.

entities/matplotlib.title: Matplotlib
entities/matplotlib.summary: A Python plotting library used in the LLM-KB workflow to generate data visualizations that are saved as images and viewed within Obsidian alongside wiki articles.

entities/memex.title: Memex
entities/memex.summary: Vannevar Bush's 1945 vision of a personal knowledge device with associative cross-referencing -- the conceptual ancestor of hypertext, wikis, and LLM-maintained knowledge bases.

entities/mongodb.title: MongoDB
entities/mongodb.summary: A document database with vector search capabilities used as the storage and retrieval backend in the Decoding AI production RAG pipeline for second-brain AI assistants.

entities/neo4j.title: Neo4j
entities/neo4j.summary: A native graph database used as the backend for Graphiti's temporal context graphs, providing mature graph query and visualization capabilities.

entities/notion.title: Notion
entities/notion.summary: A popular knowledge management and productivity tool that represents the traditional, manually-maintained approach to personal knowledge management -- the baseline against which LLM-maintained systems are compared.

entities/obsidian-web-clipper.title: Obsidian Web Clipper
entities/obsidian-web-clipper.summary: A browser extension for converting web articles into markdown files for ingestion into the raw/ directory of an LLM knowledge base.

entities/obsidian.title: Obsidian
entities/obsidian.summary: A markdown-based knowledge management application used as the read-only frontend IDE for LLM-maintained wikis in Karpathy's workflow.

entities/pgvector.title: pgvector
entities/pgvector.summary: A PostgreSQL extension for vector similarity search, widely regarded as sufficient for most team-scale retrieval use cases without requiring dedicated vector database infrastructure.

entities/sam-gallagher.title: Sam Gallagher
entities/sam-gallagher.summary: Developer who built the Knowledge Graph Kit, an open-source MCP server using SQLite and ChromaDB, as a structure-first alternative to markdown-based personal knowledge management.

entities/sqlite.title: SQLite
entities/sqlite.summary: A lightweight, serverless relational database used as the structural storage layer in Gallagher's Knowledge Graph Kit for personal knowledge management.

entities/steph-ango.title: Steph Ango
entities/steph-ango.summary: CEO of Obsidian who recommended vault separation as a strategy to prevent LLM hallucination contamination in personal knowledge bases.

entities/storm.title: STORM
entities/storm.summary: A research system for automated Wikipedia-style article creation using multi-perspective question-asking and retrieval-based outline synthesis.

entities/vannevar-bush.title: Vannevar Bush
entities/vannevar-bush.summary: American engineer and science administrator who envisioned the Memex in 1945 -- a proto-hypertext personal knowledge device that prefigured modern LLM knowledge bases by 80 years.

entities/vespa.title: Vespa.ai
entities/vespa.summary: Yahoo's hybrid search engine combining vector, keyword, and metadata search with multi-vector indexing -- described as underappreciated in the HN vector database debate.

entities/zenml.title: ZenML
entities/zenml.summary: An open-source MLOps pipeline orchestration framework used in the Decoding AI second-brain RAG system to manage offline data processing and training workflows.

entities/zep.title: Zep
entities/zep.summary: The organization behind Graphiti, offering both an open-source temporal context graph engine and enterprise-grade managed infrastructure for AI agent memory.
